images.caption: Figure 2:A shield-collapse trajectory on the Level 2 onion task.AEGIS repeatedly intervenes near the bottles and eventually times out.FailBankuses observe-only CBF supervision and successfully places the onion in the bowl.

Figure 3:The four-stageFailBankloop.Stage 1 collects policy-controlled rollouts while logging CBF proposals without altering execution. Stage 2 discards invalid records and filters valid records into CBF-triggered corrections and quiet anchors, assigning their targets and weights. Stage 3 accumulates the valid records in the training bank. Stage 4 fits a fresh LoRA adapter and accepts the candidate policy only if it passes the held-out guard. The accepted policy is then used to collect rollouts in the next round.
